shared_elements: carved relief detailing of hair or headdress
justification: Both surfaces show a robed anthropomorphic figure with rendered hair/headdress and prominent circular disc motifs on the body or field, but these are generic conventions rather than a shared distinctive scheme. B is a wide, bilaterally symmetric composition of winged attendants flanking an elaborate palmette tree above a band of script, whereas A is a single vertical frontal figure with a necklace-like chain of discs and a belt, with no tree, no wings, no flanking pair and no inscription band.
